# TauTilde {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
TauTilde()
```
Chart choice for spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs): the statistic $\tilde{\tau} = \tilde{p}_3 - 1/3$, based on the third type frequency of the refined SOP classification.
 


:::
